maya: CI alert: microbench `batcher_tail_probe` failed threshold on PR-18290 after merge. +13.4% median latency vs baseline, threshold is 5%. Suspect kernel-selector refactor.

perf-bot: Bench report: test=batcher_tail_probe
baseline=1.02ms
head=1.16ms
delta=+13.7% (> +5% threshold) -> FAIL
report: https://ci.internal/redwood/bench/18290

liam: Can repro locally on my g4dn dev VM with `--kernel=autoselect`. Seeing +12% median and some tail growth. Command I ran:
```
./tools/microbench --test batcher_tail_probe --runs 100 --kernel autoselect
```

nora: Noted. Recent change 9f3a2c4 adjusted kernel scoring by adding `cost_penalty` for small sequences. That could bias to heavier kernels under certain seqlen distributions and increase coldpath work (KV misses).

sam: Starting bisect across commits `9e1..a12` -> `9f3a2c4`. I'll run binary-search with the perf harness and upload flamegraphs. ETA ~30m.

maya: CI logs (excerpt):

deploy-bot: Canary rollout paused for `canary/gpu-serve` due to perf regression :no_entry_sign:.

liam: If bisect implicates kernel selector, recommend revert + minimal test to cover scoring edgecases. Assigning to @nora to triage.

nora: I'll take it. Will wait for bisect results and flamegraphs from @sam then open a revert PR if confirmed. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
